use_case_summary: Workload: hybrid — nightly offline re-score of ~50M docs (batch), plus online top-k reranking for product search UI (low-latency p50 target).
Latency targets: online rerank p50 <= 120ms, p95 <= 350ms for US region; acceptable higher latency for offline jobs (hours window).
Throughput: offline batch jobs need sustained throughput ~200-400 qps equivalent; online rerank calls expected peak 250 rps during release days.
Quality: customer owns eval set (2k queries + labels). Wants Redwood to run comparisons vs baseline BM25+MonoBERT and provide NDCG/MRR deltas.
Routing/fallback: prefer smart routing — Hosted for baseline, Dedicated for peak windows; automatic fallback to smaller quantized model if Dedicated capacity maxed.
Cost sensitivity: prioritize cost/performance — would accept small quality degradation if unit cost drops >=20% for nightly runs.
poc_details: Scope: 2-week POC — week 1 offline reranking of provided eval set + 50k sampled documents; week 2 online A/B with top-k replacement on staging UI.
Deliverables: baseline metrics (BM25 baseline), Redwood rerank scores, latency profile, per-query score deltas, and an eval report (NDCG@5/10, MRR).
Data exchange: drive link with anonymized sample dataset; will require signed DPA and EEA addendum for EU samples if using Hosted in-region.
Instrumentation: want token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency dashboard and trace links during POC; will use Redwood Console for monitoring.
Success criteria: +5% NDCG@10 over baseline OR equivalent cost savings with comparable quality; no critical security blockers in SOC2 review.
Pricing ask: clear SKU for nightly offline scoring (per-100k docs) + reserved slot pricing for Dedicated pool during POC and 3-month ramp.
Decision makers: VP Product (Priya Shah) and Finance Manager (Oliver Chen) — need a one-page ROI doc targeted at Finance.
